title: Invoice Reminder Generator
subtitle: Generate a polite, professional payment reminder email in seconds — no more awkward follow-ups.
resultDisclaimer: This is a template. Review and personalize before sending — a human-sounding reminder always works better than a mass email.
whyText: Most late invoices aren't paid late out of malice — they're simply forgotten, misplaced, or stuck in an approval queue. A short, professional reminder sent at the right moment resolves the majority of cases without damaging the client relationship. The key is matching the tone to the elapsed time: friendly early, firm in the middle, formal near the end, and only escalate to a final notice after 45 days.
actionFriendly: Assume it slipped through; ask if they need a re-sent invoice
actionFirm: Confirm receipt, ask for a payment date
actionFinal: State that you will suspend work or escalate
tip1: Invoice immediately. Send the invoice the same day you deliver the work — not next week.
tip2: Make payment frictionless. Include a direct payment link or bank details in every invoice.
tip3: State your terms upfront. NET 15, NET 30, or "due on receipt" — and put it in the contract.
tip4: Add late fees to your contract. Even 1.5% per month gives you leverage without hurting the relationship.
tip5: Follow up on a schedule. Day 7, 14, 30, and 45. Consistency matters more than tone.
tip6: Keep the paper trail. BCC yourself, keep a log of who you spoke to and when.
faq1q: How do I ask for payment without sounding rude?
faq1a: Assume the best. Open with "I hope this finds you well" and follow with "I wanted to check in on Invoice #X, which was due on [date]." Never accuse; ask. If you need to escalate, reference your agreed terms rather than implying bad faith.
faq2q: How soon should I follow up on an unpaid invoice?
faq2a: Send the first reminder one day after the due date. If no response, follow up on days 7, 14, 30, and 45. Escalate to a formal notice after 45 days, and consider a collections agency after 90 days.
faq3a: Yes, if your contract allows it. A common rate is 1.5% per month (18% per year). The goal isn't to punish — it's to give the client a reason to prioritize your invoice over the dozens of others in their queue.
faq4q: What if the client ghosted me completely?
faq4a: Try every channel: email, phone, and any project management tool you shared. After three attempts with no response, send a formal final notice by email with a read receipt, and copy any other stakeholders on the client side. Then decide whether to pursue small claims court or write it off.
faq5q: When should I stop working for a client who hasn't paid?
faq5a: Most freelancers pause new work once an invoice is 30 days overdue, and stop entirely at 60 days. Continuing to deliver while unpaid signals that your deadlines are optional — and makes the invoice less likely to be paid, not more.
disclaimer: Disclaimer: These templates are provided for informational purposes. They are not legal advice. Consult a lawyer or contract professional for formal collection procedures.
footer: Runs entirely in your browser. No data is collected or stored.
bodyFriendly1: I hope you are doing well. I wanted to gently check in on invoice {inv} for {amt}, which was due on {date}.
bodyFriendly2: If it has already been processed, please disregard this message — and thanks! If it slipped through, no worries at all; here is a fresh copy for your convenience.
bodyFirm1: I am following up on invoice {inv} for {amt}, which was due on {date} and is now overdue.
bodyFirm2: Could you confirm whether the invoice has been received and when we can expect payment? If there is an issue with the invoice itself, please let me know and I will address it right away.
bodyFormal1: This is a formal reminder that invoice {inv} for {amt} remains unpaid. The original due date was {date}, and it is now significantly overdue.
bodyFormal2: Per our agreement, payment terms are NET 30, and late payments may incur a fee of 1.5% per month as outlined in our contract. To avoid additional charges, please arrange payment within the next 7 business days.
bodyFinal1: This is a final notice regarding invoice {inv} for {amt}, originally due on {date}.
bodyFinal2: Despite multiple reminders, payment has not been received. If payment is not arranged within 5 business days, I will have to suspend all ongoing work and may refer this invoice to a collections service.
bodyFinal3: I would much prefer to resolve this directly. Please contact me as soon as possible to confirm a payment date, or to discuss any issue preventing payment.
bodyFriendlyClose: Let me know if you need anything else from my end.
bodyFirmClose: A quick reply with an expected payment date would be much appreciated.
bodyFormalClose: If there is a dispute or any reason for the delay that I am not aware of, please contact me directly so we can resolve it.
